context.note: No live server exists yet, so no /played or armory data. The beta is the only population that has levelled 1-30.

High Order Skyborne: Read Ley Line: +100% Health and Mana regeneration
Wind Blessed (passive): +3% melee, ranged and spellcasting haste
Walk on Air: glide for 10s, 1.5m CD
Night Elf: Wisp Spirit: +75% movement speed as a ghost
Dwarf: Earth Fury: +2% crit with all spells and attacks
Big Game Hunter: +5% damage to Beasts
Gnome: Eureka!: reduced cost and +10% damage for 8s
Troll: Regeneration: +20% health regen, 20% continues in combat
Rapid Regeneration: regenerate 50% of maximum health over time
Tauren: Plainsrunning: movement speed grows while moving, +3% mounted
War Stomp: stuns up to 5 enemies 2s
Undead: Touch of the Grave: 20% chance to drain up to 5% of max health
Cannibalize: 7% health and mana every 2s for 10s
Orc: Blood Fury: +10% Attack Power and Spell Power 15s
Savage: +1% crit with all spells and abilities
Windshaper Skyborne: Wind Blessed (passive): +3% melee, ranged and spellcasting haste

thirdPartyBetaTierLists._caveat: All measure level-30 combat DPS in sims or dungeon logs, not levelling speed, and they disagree.
thirdPartyBetaTierLists.MythicSim via kami-labs (7 Oct): Fury Warrior 862 DPS, Survival Hunter 819 DPS
thirdPartyBetaTierLists.Mobalytics Crix (11 Oct): ranked on dungeon performance, 'absolutely subject to change'
